# Extra tools staged with the main set (DECISIONS D11). Installed with env/install_offline.sh.
pytest-xdist     # run the test suite on 12 cores (pytest -n 12)
psutil           # CPU / RAM monitoring inside long runs
seaborn          # report figures
motmetrics       # IDF1 / ID switches (Phase 4, CLAUDE.md Section 9)
tabulate         # tables in REPORT.md
ipython          # interactive debugging on the HPC
pip
wheel
